einzeiler: Spittin' Chiclets breaks down the Internet Invitational aftermath and NHL storylines.
kurzfassung: The hosts review the chaotic conclusion of the Internet Invitational with guests Big John and Salim, discussing the heavy drinking and the fallout. They also analyze the latest NHL news, including drama surrounding Matvei Michkov in Philadelphia and Jacob Chychrun's massive hit on Nick Cousins. Later, Trip Tracy joins the show to discuss the Carolina Hurricanes in Finland, followed by RA's World.
stichpunkte: Salim and Big John join the show to discuss the wild conclusion of the Internet Invitational.
Salim opens up about his heavy drinking during the tournament and his decision to start a 90-day sober challenge.
The hosts analyze the fierce debate surrounding Matvei Michkov and the toxic atmosphere in Philadelphia.
Jacob Chychrun delivers a massive, clean open-ice hit on Nick Cousins during an Ottawa game.
Trip Tracy joins from Finland to discuss the Carolina Hurricanes' success and Sebastian Aho's stellar play.
The guys talk about Taylor Hall playing his 1000th NHL game overseas.
RA shares documentary recommendations and hosts a spelling segment during RA's World.

clips.text: After a clutch putt went in during the tournament, a small family-owned putter shop sold one thousand putters in a single day.

beschreibung:
On Episode 684 of Spittin’ Chiclets, The boys are joined by Big John and Salim to talk about the epic final round of the Internet Invitational and all that went down. Major storylines coming out of this one going into the next tournament. Tripp Tracy stops by to talk Carolina and their domination. Can anyone stop them this year? This is an episode you won’t want to miss.
